bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
SOURCE_SHA=38edb681675101d2023d154671f98dc4a7dada67
RUN_ID=44662287852
ROOT="$HOME/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/offline-artifacts/$SOURCE_SHA"
test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1)" = "sha256:79ee66291b1e52ae71460cde30e752b5cd356d97ff2cf2fd307797b99b823cd4" || { echo 'LIVE_IMAGE_CHANGED_ABORT'; exit 75; }
command -v gh >/dev/null; command -v docker >/dev/null; command -v gzip >/dev/null
mkdir -p "$ROOT"
if [ ! -f "$ROOT/create-videobot-image.tar.gz" ]; then
  gh run download "$RUN_ID" --repo seigo-gace/create-videobot --name "create-videobot-offline-$SOURCE_SHA" --dir "$ROOT"
fi
cd "$ROOT"
sha256sum -c create-videobot-image.tar.gz.sha256 >/dev/null
printf 'OFFLINE_ARTIFACT_CHECKSUM=PASS\n'
gzip -dc create-videobot-image.tar.gz | docker load >/dev/null
printf 'STAGED_IMAGE_ID='; docker image inspect create-videobot:local-telegram --format '{{.Id}}'
printf 'ACTIVE_POLL_IMAGE_UNCHANGED='; docker inspect gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1 --format '{{.Image}}'
printf 'STAGED_SHA=%s\n' "$SOURCE_SHA"
